# Cozy Critters
This is the official source of Cozy Critters pack.

## Structure
- **/config** - Configs that have changed from their **default** value
- **/kubejs** - Custom Scripts used in-game ([Docs](https://kubejs.com/))
  - **/assets** - Acts as a resource pack
  - **/data** - Acts as a datapack
  - **/client_scripts** - Client-side scripts to run
  - **/server_scripts** - Server-side scripts to run
  - **/startup_scripts** - Start-up scripts, usually shared
